prompt: Open 1IRO as its biological assembly 1, the trimer, not the deposited asymmetric unit, and colour residues 1-9 purple.

checks: schema-valid; replays with nothing ignored or unresolved (scripts/check_api_refs.py)

each of the 1 selection(s) selects exactly the atoms written a second time in provenance.targets (author chain, author number and residue name, or label chains / label ranges from the frozen facts), resolved by molbench.atoms
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (F1 1, success, target score 1)
a near miss (first colour changed, or last step dropped) is not a success and earns partial credit (F1 0.75)
equivalent answer succeeds: assembly_id 'preferred' (the first assembly)
equivalent answer succeeds: label chain and label range
wrong answer fails: assembly_id set after the load (it is only read when a structure is loaded) (F1 0.6667)
provenance.derived: Assembly 1 is built by symmetry from every deposited polymer chain (frozen facts: trimeric, 3 chains), so it differs from the deposited model. Atoms are compared on the deposited unit; the assembly is a fact of the state.
